annotations.title: Make one of my CVs the primary CV

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Makes one of the user's editable CVs their primary CV (CV chính), used for matching and referrals. Replaces the current primary CV file, which is not kept: call it only when the user asked. If a primary CV exists, the first call changes nothing and says what would be replaced; ask the user, then repeat with confirm_replace true.

confirm_replace.description: true only after the user agreed, in their own reply, to replace their current primary CV file.

cv_id.description: Id of the editable CV to make the primary CV, from list_my_cvs or create_cv_variant.

name: set_primary_cv
